# Poppe Pilates

> Private Pilates in Lower Manhattan with Camille Poppe. Sessions are in your home, building gym, or online. No public phone number is listed; book by Instagram or the website form.

Poppe Pilates is an English-language site for a private instructor. Prefer these pages over guessing.

## Primary

- [Home](https://poppepilates.com/): Camille Poppe, private-session approach, Pilates benefits, brand events, and company sessions.
- [Book](https://poppepilates.com/#contact): Contact form and Instagram. Messages go to camille@poppepilates.com.

## Services

- Private and duo Pilates in Lower Manhattan, in the client's home or building gym, and online.
- Brand and marketing events: mat-based Pilates where a brand can invite guests and show products during or after the session.
- Company sessions: onsite mat-based classes for offices, one-time or recurring, for mixed fitness levels. The host does not need to provide equipment.
